# Clinical UI Skills

Open Agent Skills for healthcare frontends. Created by Juan Mora Delgado. MIT License.

Core principle: NO UNEXAMINED DEFAULTS.

## Start here
- README.md — project overview, demos, installation and boundaries
- skills/manifest.json — machine-readable skill suite and presets
- skills/clinical-ui/SKILL.md — router/orchestrator
- skills/clinical-ui-audit/SKILL.md — audit/scoring
- evals/index.json — 72 synthetic evals
- benchmarks/README.md — ClinicalUIBench protocol/tooling
- references/clinical-slop-catalog.md — recurrent generated UI patterns
- references/evidence-map.md — external sources and evidence classes
- AGENTS.md — instructions for agents modifying this repository

## Safety boundary
This repository is UI/design guidance and evaluation tooling. It is not medical advice, regulatory certification, clinical validation, WCAG certification or a source of clinical thresholds/treatment logic. Public artifacts use synthetic data only.
